subject: resnet8-cifar10-niosless-jtag-340mhz

tool_versions.openvino: 2025.4.0 (runtime install only; not in the deploy loop)

notes: Same Nios-less k16/c8 design as ph4_*full10k*, clocked at the die's practical ceiling: dla_clk 340.000 MHz, ddr_clk 130.769 MHz (IOPLL VCO 1700, M=68, C0=13, C1=5). 340 sits 0.9% under the hard Minimum-Pulse-Width silicon limit of this -E7S speed grade (Quartus Restricted Fmax 342.94 MHz; a 375 MHz build met setup/hold/recovery but failed MPW at -0.250 ns and was rejected). Timing met on every check: dla setup +0.157 ns, MPW +0.025 ns. METRICS: single-stream engine latency 459.05 us = 60,029 ddr ticks x 7.64706 ns (jobs_active-gated CLOCKS_ACTIVE; tick is 7.647 ns here because ddr_clk=130.769 MHz - not the 10 ns of the 100 MHz builds) -> 2,178.4 fps; pipelined marginal job 440.39 us at descriptor-queue depth >= 8 -> 2,270.7 fps (fit: ticks(N)=57,590N+2,439, saturated at depth 8). Empirical scaling law across all measured rungs: job_us = 141,840/f_dla_MHz + fixed (fixed term 54.77 us at ddr 100 MHz, 41.9 us at 130.769 MHz); the 205 KB per-job parameter re-fetch was directly measured to be only ~6% of the job and is not the bottleneck. ACCURACY: official MLPerf Tiny ic01 200-image class-balanced subset (perf_samples_idxs.npy), 168/200 = 84.00% - bit-identical logits, class decisions, and confusion matrix to the full-10k build (which scored 86.33% on all 10,000; at n=200 the sampling SE is ~2.6 pp so 84.00% is statistically consistent with both the 85% floor and the 86.5% reference). Bit-exactness across the clock change was verified on all 200 ic01 images plus the deterministic synthetic self-check. Remaining headroom on this die is blocked, not unexplored: the 2x k16c16 core (256 MACs/cycle) was built and measured at 295.73 us but returns constant logits because it only fits via the defective enable_on_chip_parameters mode; with working DDR-served parameters it needs ~275 M20K vs the C100's 262. NOT an official MLPerf Tiny submission.
